notes: The supplied text has no section for the IGETC/Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement. It only mentions Cal-GETC as 'Option Two' for associate degree general education, with no course list, areas or unit totals.

The only course lists in the text belong to the Local General Education Pattern (27 units) for the associate degree. That is a different requirement set, so it was not recorded as this certificate's blocks.
Many closed-list courses appear in those local GE lists. The certificate's own course areas need to be read from the catalog's Cal-GETC/IGETC (Transfer Planning) page.

The outcomes at the top of the text are general education area outcomes (GE-Ethnic Studies, GE-Lifelong Learning, GE-American History & Ideals, and a cut-off science area). None is a program outcome stated for this certificate, so outcomes were left empty.
The text names no careers for this program.

No program-level total, GE units or degree total for this award is printed, and ge_pattern was left null. A reviewer may consider ge_pattern 'Cal-GETC' if the certificate is taken to be the Cal-GETC pattern itself.
